market.question: Will the highest temperature in Wuhan be 29°C on May 5?

assessment.reasoning: Wuhan early May average highs ~26°C with daily range up to ~31°C. The 29°C single-degree bucket is on the warm side of the forecast. Without a specific model forecast for May 5 above 28°C and given typical forecast spread, probability is modest.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Specific synoptic pattern May 5; warm-air advection could push above forecast.
